items.text: **Autopilot will not commit P94 (`cc-autopilot.ps1:423`).** - My first P94 STOPPED (06:01) set `lastHandled` to 94 (`:413`). items.what: **The reset rule (P72 C.4)**, for when player levels and loops exist. Recommended
items.expect: - **item level is kept through every reset**; - **bonuses above the wearer's current level plus Arms Lore attunement go dormant, but the item stays wearable**; - **an item cannot level past its owner's max level**; - a companion's gear acts at its owner's level plus the owner's attunement. The alternative is F-12 read literally: the item's level is the equip requirement, which makes high item levels capstone-only. Nothing in this build depends on a player level. The read-time design means dormancy will be one test in `EffectiveBonus`, with no item rewrite.

items.what: **Pacing**, to be set by playtest. With the stock curve (4.04 M XP at 200) and the pool being Bard difficulty (at most 160 under SE, paragons included), one player soloing the hardest creatures needs at least about 25,000 kills to reach 200. That is about 210 hours at P72's 120 kills an hour, and far more at ordinary difficulty. A share split makes a party slower per person. `xpMultiplier`, `curveBase` and `curveOffset` are the knobs. This is arithmetic from the formulas, not measured play.
